description: A long chain of connected sumti costs work in proportion to its length. Four times the links cost at most about four times the work, where a condition over the whole prefix gives about ten times.
A long chain of connected terms costs work in proportion to its length. Four times the links cost at most about four times the work, where a condition over the whole prefix gives about ten times.

A long chain of connected sumti joined with bo costs work in proportion to its length. Four times the links cost at most about four times the work, where a condition over the whole prefix gives about ten times.

A long chain of connected terms joined with bo costs work in proportion to its length. Four times the links cost at most about four times the work, where a condition over the whole prefix gives about ten times.
